scope: Ordinary unquantized BF16 selection-only adaptation, one thought type. Each dataset uses its own matched-decoder FullKV control; no legacy/SideQuest/heterogeneous-decoder comparison and no official CT-kernel throughput claim.
pairing: Mean two clean repeats within question, then pair by question ID. Bootstrap 20 paired question differences with replacement. Delta = selection minus own control; negative means faster. Diagnostics never enter clean CIs.
